_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
We ku Mcheza {player_id}, kukhala {num_rounds} mizinga ya Iterated Ultimatum Game.
Inu ndi ${pool} kupanga mizingu ili kati inu na Mcheza {other_id}.

Mlembi:
  - Tengera chilango: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Ili ikhale ikupitidwa → Inu khala $(pool - X), mcheza wina khale $X
  - Ili ikana → Awiri khala $0
  - Mfano: [Offer: $3]  or  'Inaona ngati ina ngozi. [Offer: $5]'

Mlembi akuluza:
  - Tengera chilango na [Accept] kapena [Reject]
  - Mfano: 'Inaoneka ngati ina ngozi. [Accept]'
            'Ino ndi laji. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Mizingu {round_number} yanayanza! ---
Mcheza {proposer_id} ndi mlembi, Mcheza {responder_id} ndi mlembi akuluza.
round.accepted: Mcheza {responder_id} ikupitidwa! Mizingu {round_number} ufumu: Mcheza {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Mcheza {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Jumla mpya: Mcheza 0: ${total_0}, Mcheza 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Mcheza {responder_id} ikana chilango! Mizingu {round_number} ufumu: Awiri ochira +$0. Jumla ilipo: Mcheza 0: ${total_0}, Mcheza 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Wopempha ayenera kupereka ntchito pogwiritsa ntchito mtundu wa [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Ndalama zimene akupereka ziyenera kukhala nambala yathunthu.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Ndalama zimene akupereka ziyenera kukhala pakati pa $0 ndi ${pool}.

outcome.win: Mcheza {winner} wina ndi ${winner_total} jumla vs Mcheza {loser}'s ${loser_total}.
